Manuel, 58, a former Michigan football player who has held the job as the university's athletic director since 2016, has never been cited for being involved in any of the scandals.

memorySnippets.articleSummary: Music-industry groups are proposing voluntary labels for recordings made with generative AI so listeners can distinguish fully AI-generated tracks from songs where human artists used AI assistance. The proposal comes from organizations including the Recording Industry Association of America, the Recording Academy, SAG-AFTRA, and other music groups that want a unified labeling approach for streaming services and other platforms. Under the proposal, a large AI label would identify fully AI-generated recordings, while a smaller ai marker would flag songs where AI was used as a tool in the creative process. Industry leaders said the goal is transparency as AI-generated uploads increase and artists, labels, platforms, and fans debate how authorship should be identified. The timing and platform adoption remain unresolved. Streaming services would still need to decide whether to use the labels and how the markers would appear to listeners.

memorySnippets.summary: Music-industry groups are proposing voluntary labels for AI-generated and AI-assisted recordings so listeners can better understand how generative tools were used in songs.
knownFacts: Music-industry groups proposed labels that would identify fully AI-generated recordings and songs where AI was used as an assistive tool.

memorySnippets.articleSummary: Music-industry groups are proposing voluntary labels for recordings made with generative AI so listeners can distinguish fully AI-generated tracks from songs where human artists used AI assistance. The proposal comes from organizations including the Recording Industry Association of America, the Recording Academy, SAG-AFTRA, and other music groups that want a unified labeling approach for streaming services and other platforms. Under the proposal, a large AI label would identify fully AI-generated recordings, while a smaller ai marker would flag songs where AI was used as a tool in the creative process. Industry leaders said the goal is transparency as AI-generated uploads increase and artists, labels, platforms, and fans debate how authorship should be identified. The timing and platform adoption remain unresolved. Streaming services would still need to decide whether to use the labels and how the markers would appear to listeners.

edges.title: Record Industry Proposes Labels for AI-Generated Music
edges.summary: Music-industry groups are proposing voluntary labels for AI-generated and AI-assisted recordings so listeners can better understand how generative tools were used in songs.
edges.articleSummary: Music-industry groups are proposing voluntary labels for recordings made with generative AI so listeners can distinguish fully AI-generated tracks from songs where human artists used AI assistance. The proposal comes from organizations including the Recording Industry Association of America, the Recording Academy, SAG-AFTRA, and other music groups that want a unified labeling approach for streaming services and other platforms. Under the proposal, a large AI label would identify fully AI-generated recordings, while a smaller ai marker would flag songs where AI was used as a tool in the creative process. Industry leaders said the goal is transparency as AI-generated uploads increase and artists, labels, platforms, and fans debate how authorship should be identified. The timing and platform adoption remain unresolved. Streaming services would still need to decide whether to use the labels and how the markers would appear to listeners.
